bootstrap: Diagnosis-by-site stratified participant pairs; control SD and adjusted coefficients refitted each draw; percentile intervals; failure proportion reported
tract_set: One post hoc native-unit patient-level anterior-minus-comparator outcome; no posterior gradient or independent validation claimed
age68: Group-by-age model on observed overlap; two-outcome exploratory BH family; approximate Welch HC3 inference
limits: No acquisition harmonization or disease-by-scanner test. Percentile intervals are marginal, not multiplicity-adjusted. Sparse site strata condition bootstrap uncertainty on observed sites.
